newsitem.title: USA: Chubb Q4 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: Chubb Q4 oper shr rises.

text.p: Oper shr $0.95 $0.89
Net shr 1.15 1.09
TWELVE MONTHS
Oper shr $3.58 $3.46
Net shr 3.91 3.93
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: The company did not provide consolidated revenue figures. The company also did not provide information on the average shares outstanding.
Net premiums written in the property-casualty business rose 12.7 percent to $1.2 billion in the fourth quarter of 1996.
Net premiums written rose 10.9 percent to $4.8 billion for the full year 1996.
The combined ratio rose to 98.4 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 compared with 97.6 percent a year ago.
For the full year, the combined ratio rose to 98.3 percent from 96.8 percent in 1995.
Life and health insurance income after taxes amounted to $12.9 million in the fourth quarter compared with $6.2 million a year ago.
For the year, life and health insurance income was $40.3 million compared with $28.0 million in 1995.

Real estate income after taxes was $3.2 million in the fourth quarter compared with $2.5 million a year ago. For the full year, real estate income was $13.2 million compared with $6.0 million a year ago.
The First Call Q4 consensus estimate was $0.99 a share.
Per share amounts have been retroactively adjusted to reflect the two-for-one stock split effective April 19, 1996.
